metadata.description: Saphion's own plugins for Beacon: documents and files, deep research, design, RAMS, tenders, meeting recaps and the skill creator.

plugins.name: dataviz
plugins.description: Ask Beacon for a dashboard app, or one over data that is not in Saphion: its figures worked out in code, drawn and kept in one place.

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Research a question properly across many sources and get a cited report that takes a position.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Palette, type and layout for pages, and polished single-file apps for the side pane.

plugins.name: meeting-recaps
plugins.description: Recap styles for meetings: a general recap, board and committee minutes, one-to-ones, project and team updates, client meetings, sales calls and interviews.

plugins.name: rams
plugins.description: Risk assessments and method statements written from your Organisation's own two Word templates and Hazard library.

plugins.name: saphion-documents
plugins.description: Word and PDF files, spreadsheets and presentations Beacon makes and edits by itself.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Make or change your own skills by talking the job through with Beacon, trying a draft on a real example, and saving it.

plugins.name: tenders
plugins.description: A source-grounded tender response prepared from a tender pack, for human review.
